## General Summary

This document is a proposed City Resolution for the year 2026. It seeks to declare operative in its entirety the Annual Budget of the Sangguniang Kabataan (SK) of Barangay Pinagbakahan for Calendar Year 2026. The budget amount is One Million Three Hundred Fifty-Five Thousand Seven Hundred Seventy-Three Pesos and 30/100 Centavos (PHP1,355,773.30). The resolution is authored by Hon. Dennis D. San Diego, City Councilor. It cites Section 333 of Republic Act 7160, also known as the Local Government Code of 1991, as the legal basis for the Sangguniang Panlungsod's authority to review barangay budget ordinances. After review, the budget was found compliant with the requirements of the Local Government Code and other existing laws, and the resolution formally declares the budget operative.

## Page Range Breakdown

### Page 1

This page contains the full text of the proposed City Resolution. It includes the title, author attribution, and the preamble citing the relevant legal authority under the Local Government Code of 1991. It establishes that the Sangguniang Kabataan of Barangay Pinagbakahan submitted its Annual Budget for Calendar Year 2026 in the amount of PHP1,355,773.30, and that the Sangguniang Panlungsod reviewed and found it compliant. The resolving clause declares the budget operative in its entirety. The page concludes with the name and title of the author, Atty. Dennis D. San Diego, City Councilor.
